HELP & SUPPORT

BabyFileCab User Manual

Keyboard shortcuts and workflow reference.

How to Use BabyFileCab

Start with a client, organize their documents, then plan the work on your Firm Calendar. Open a topic below for instructions.

1. Create a client

Click Add Client in the main toolbar. Enter the client’s name and contact information, choose their return type (1040, 1065, 1120S, or 1120), and save. The client appears in the document tree with a Permanent Folder and notes.txt. Right-click the client and choose Edit Client to update their information.

2. Organize tax years and sections

Select the client and choose Add Tax Year. Select that year and choose Add Section to group documents by topic. Use the Permanent Folder for documents you need across years. Creating a section leaves existing documents in their original sections.

A section must be empty before you can delete it. Delete each document first; any remaining files or subfolders prevent section deletion.

3. Upload, preview, and rename documents

Select the destination section in the document tree, click Upload, and choose your files. Click a document to preview it. Right-click a document and choose Edit to rename it. Shift + left-click another document selects a range within the same client.

To keep client notes, open notes.txt, enter your notes, and press Ctrl+S to save.

4. Find clients and documents

Open Search in the top menu and choose Search Clients or Search Documents. Search Clients helps you jump to a client in the tree. Search Documents helps you find documents by name and other available details.

5. Schedule work in the Firm Calendar

Click the calendar icon on the main page or open Tools → Firm Calendar. Search for any active client by name or ID. Select the matching client, then choose Assign a Date & Preparer.

For a scheduled client, select the assignment and choose Go to Calendar to jump to that day. Use Change Assignment to change the preparer, move the date, or update the status. You can also right-click a client on the calendar.

Statuses include Drafting, Waiting on Reports, Completed, 8879 Sent, Waiting for Signature, Signed, and Ready to E-file. Completed shows a green check mark. Clear Status removes the status label. These labels track your workflow; they do not send forms or e-file returns.

Use the initials menu in the top-right corner to view the Entire Firm or an individual preparer. Click a scheduled client to see their documents; choose Open Client in Work Space to return to their document tree. The × removes only that calendar assignment.

6. Use tools and make backups

Under Tools, open the tax calculator, engagement letter generator, invoice creator, currency converter, or audit trail as needed.

Open File → Back Up Client Files…, select the client, and choose where to save the encrypted .bfcbackup file. Keep your backups somewhere safe. A client backup is different from a complete copy of the company workspace and its vault-key files.

7. Adjust settings and protect your workspace

Use Settings to switch light/dark themes, change your password, or choose an inactivity lock of 15, 30, or 45 minutes. Under Keyboard Shortcuts, select a numbered binding, click Modify, choose the modifiers and key, then save your changes.

Use File → Sign Out when leaving the computer. Keep your company data and vault-key files backed up together; losing the key files can prevent access to encrypted documents. Help → Open Data Folder shows where the app stores its data. Avoid moving or deleting files there while BabyFileCab is running.

Main application

Shift + left-click selects a range of documents. G then S opens Settings. Change keyboard mappings under Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts.

Client notes (notes.txt)

Ctrl+SSave the current client notes. Ctrl+BToggle bold formatting while editing client notes. Ctrl+IToggle italic formatting while editing client notes. Ctrl+UToggle underline formatting while editing client notes.

Client Backup

FileChoose Back Up Client Files…, directly below Client Communications, to open the full active client list. ClientSelect one client to create an encrypted .bfcbackup archive containing that client's files and metadata. Ctrl+BOpen the same client backup window from the main workspace.

After choosing a client, BabyFileCab asks where to save the encrypted backup. Creating a backup does not change or remove the client's original files.

Firm Calendar

ToolsOpen Firm Calendar… to schedule clients on the 2026 weekly calendar. ← / →Move backward or forward one week. WeekUse the week dropdown to jump directly to another week of 2026. ＋Assign one or more clients to a calendar day. Multiple clients can share the same date. ClientEach scheduled client shows its return type (1040, 1065, 1120S, or 1120). Click the client name to view the client's Permanent Folder and documents organized by tax year. Right-click ClientOpen the calendar client menu and choose Reassign to New Date… to move that client to another 2026 date. ×Remove a client assignment from that day without deleting the client or any documents.

Firm Calendar assignments are stored inside the local company workspace so users signed into the same local BabyFileCab company see the same schedule.

Engagement Letter

ToolsOpen Engagement Letter Generator… to create a CPA firm engagement letter from information already stored in BabyFileCab. LogoUse Browse Logo… to choose a PNG or JPEG firm logo. The logo is saved for the current company account and appears in the preview and generated letters. ClientUse the Client dropdown to choose any active client already entered in BabyFileCab. The client name, address, phone, and email are pulled from that client profile. PreparerUse the Preparer dropdown to choose an Administrator or Staff user. BabyFileCab uses that preparer's stored name, company, address, phone, and email in the letter. ServiceUse the Service dropdown to independently choose 1040, 1041, 1065, 1120S, 1120, Bookkeeping, or Tax Projection. Tax YearChoose a tax year from 2018 through 2026. FeeChoose Flat Fee or Hourly Rate and enter the agreed amount in U.S. dollars. GenerateAt the bottom of the generator, click Generate PDF Document or Generate MS Word Document to create the finished engagement letter from the selections shown in the preview.

Choose the company logo, client, preparer, service, tax year (2018–2026), and fee arrangement. Client, preparer, service, tax year, and fee arrangement are real dropdown controls. The preview updates automatically, and the buttons at the bottom generate the finished PDF or Microsoft Word engagement letter.

Create an Invoice

ToolsOpen Create an Invoice… to build a client invoice from information stored in BabyFileCab. ClientChoose an existing BabyFileCab client. The saved client name, address, phone, and email are used in the invoice. BillingChoose a service and tax year, then select Flat Fee or Hourly Rate. Hourly invoices calculate the total from hours × hourly rate. GenerateScroll to the bottom and choose Generate MS Word Document or Generate PDF Document.

Currency Converter (IRS)

ToolsOpen Currency Converter (IRS)… to convert between U.S. dollars and currencies listed in the IRS yearly-average exchange-rate table. YearChoose an IRS yearly-average rate year from 2021 through 2025. DirectionConvert foreign currency to USD or USD to foreign currency. CurrencyChoose the country/currency from the IRS table, enter an amount, and BabyFileCab applies the selected yearly-average rate.

The IRS states that it has no official exchange rate and generally accepts a posted rate used consistently. The IRS page says to divide a foreign-currency amount by the yearly-average table rate to convert it to U.S. dollars, and multiply a U.S.-dollar amount by the rate to convert it to foreign currency. For a specific transaction, the applicable spot rate may be required instead of a yearly average.

Audit Trail

ToolsOpen Audit Trail… to review company-wide BabyFileCab activity. SearchFilter the history by user, client, action, or details. RefreshReload the latest activity from the local company workspace.

The company-wide audit trail records who performed important BabyFileCab actions, when they occurred, the affected client when available, and the action details. Existing per-client history is imported into the company-wide trail the first time it is created.

Document Properties

Ctrl+SSave the Document Description / keywords. EscSave the Document Description and close Document Properties.

BabyFileCab file picker

BabyFileCab currently uses the operating system file picker. These standard file-picker shortcuts are supported when provided by the active Linux/Windows/macOS file dialog.

Alt+LeftGo back to the previous folder. Alt+UpGo up one folder level. F5Refresh the current folder. Ctrl+ASelect all visible files. EnterOpen the highlighted folder or choose the highlighted file(s). EscClose/cancel the file picker.

Search windows

EnterRun Global Find when the search box has focus. EnterOpen the selected Global Find result when the results list has focus. EnterMove to the next match in Find in PDF. EscClose Find in PDF.

General dialog behavior

EnterSubmit or open the selected item in many BabyFileCab dialogs. EscClose or cancel many BabyFileCab secondary windows.

ABOUT

About BabyFileCab

A local-first document management system built for tax and accounting work.

BabyFileCab is designed to give tax preparers, accountants, bookkeepers, enrolled agents, CPAs, and small accounting firms a simple place to organize client records without forcing their day-to-day document workflow into a cloud service.

The application organizes each client into a clear Work Space with a Permanent Folder, client notes, tax years, custom sections, document descriptions, previews, search tools, communications information, and local user accounts.

Designed for accounting offices

BabyFileCab is intended for professionals who regularly work with tax returns, source documents, workpapers, engagement records, correspondence, bookkeeping files, PDFs, spreadsheets, Word documents, images, CSV files, and other client records.

Local-first by design

The current BabyFileCab design keeps company workspaces, client folders, account information, and documents on the local computer. Users belonging to the same local company workspace can see the same clients and documents. Optional network or cloud sharing can be added later without changing the local-first purpose of the application.

Goal

The goal of BabyFileCab is to make client filing fast and understandable: find the client, choose the year or section, upload the document, preview it, and get back to the accounting work.
